summary: White half-page cover and warm architectural photo create a distinct editorial family; yellow marker is restrained and copy is readable.
Oversized yellow chapter number, dark sans-serif headline and generous whitespace match the business reference grammar.
Native numbered callouts sit on the actual yellow entrance, limestone wall and olive tree after anchor correction; labels remain separate editable text.
Native column chart displays 12/8/4 from a zero baseline, with the 24-project illustrative total and qualification visible.
Four stages align to one timeline, the generated stage numbers avoid repeated date labels, and each stage retains its purpose.
Three flat sections explain daylight, materials and floor plan without UI cards; final page is complete and all qualifications remain visible.

Reviewed all six exported pages against the complete fictional studio brief. White/yellow identity is consistent across cover, chapter, annotations, chart and process. Source counts and exclusions match; no clipped content observed. This is a working example, not a blinded quality benchmark.
